name: asc-release-kit
description: A coordinated App Store Connect launch kit for localized metadata, keywords, screenshots, Pixelmator PXD editing, and safe ASC API task execution.

interface.shortDescription: ASC metadata, keywords, screenshots, PXD editing, and API workflows.
interface.longDescription: Prepare localized App Store Connect updates from real app projects, including metadata copy, ASO keyword fields, Pixelmator Pro PXD screenshot assets, and explicit-confirmation ASC API task execution.
capabilities: Coordinate localized ASC launch workflows from one input packet
Draft ASC metadata and keyword fields
Generate ASC screenshot assets with Xcode UI Tests and Pixelmator Pro
Edit and export Pixelmator Pro PXD files through official AppleScript
Prepare safe ASC API task JSON before confirmed execution
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $asc-launch-workflow to prepare a localized App Store Connect launch/update packet.
